rendering_contract.column_unit: same fixed horizontal pitch for every number digit; 0-based left-to-right; negative columns are legal for operation sign/divisor
rendering_contract.row_unit: one fixed row pitch, independent reveal by complete row
rendering_contract.decimal_point: is its own explicit cell, kept in decimal_column in every row
rendering_contract.rules: rule_after spans the stated columns; not emulated with underscore text
rendering_contract.division_bracket: top_row identifies dividend row; horizontal bar immediately above that row, rounded left cap between top_row and bottom_row; quotient is row 0, divisor uses negative columns
rendering_contract.role: question rows are visible with statement; answer rows reveal after analysis; illustration does not replace damaged source glyphs
rendering_contract.source: Question strings and original diagrams were inspected through reviewed structured records; ambiguous printed p102 glyphs remain original cropped image.
